home.meta.description: Find your Greater Bengaluru Authority ward, check the election status, and get ready to vote in the GBA corporator elections.
home.hero.heading: This election, Bengaluru will elect ward councillors under the Greater Bengaluru Authority (GBA) for the first time.
home.hero.subheading: Before you vote, understand your neighbourhood, explore the candidates, see the public infrastructure around you, and learn how your local government shapes everyday life.
home.whyVote.title: Why your vote in the ward election matters.
home.whyVote.paragraph1: Bengaluru has not held local body elections since 2015, leaving neighbourhoods without direct, accountable representation in the system.
home.whyVote.paragraph2: Over these years, the city has continued to spend significant public funds worth Rs 38,455 crore annually; citizens have no clarity on where it has been spent, how spending decisions are made, or whom to hold responsible when services fall short.
home.whyVote.paragraph3: On the ground this shows up as damaged roads, uncleared garbage, overflowing drains, unusable footpaths and unreliable streetlights, without any elected representative who can be held accountable.
home.whyVote.paragraph4: This election is an opportunity to restore that link.
home.whyVote.paragraph5: Voting strengthens democracy and empowers citizens to hold local leaders accountable, allowing every citizen to shape their city. Your vote decides who represents your ward, who raises your concerns, and who holds the system to account. It shapes how your neighbourhood functions and how responsive the city becomes.
home.whyVote.closing: So vote to shape the future of your ward. And your city.
home.basics.title: Three things worth understanding.
home.basics.item1.title: What is the Greater Bengaluru Authority?
home.basics.item1.body: The Greater Bengaluru Authority (GBA) is the apex civic body for the Bengaluru metropolitan region. It coordinates planning, infrastructure and governance across the city. Under the Greater Bengaluru Governance Act, 2024, the erstwhile Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike (BBMP) has been reconstituted into multiple City Corporations (currently five), which now perform municipal functions within the Greater Bengaluru Area under the overarching coordination and supervision of the Greater Bengaluru Authority and its Executive Committee.
home.basics.item2.title: What is a ward
home.basics.item2.body: A ward is the smallest electoral unit in a city. It is the neighbourhood or group of neighbourhoods you live in. Every ward elects one councillor who works on local civic issues such as roads, parks, sanitation, drainage, streetlights, and neighbourhood infrastructure.
home.basics.item3.title: What is a ward councillor?
home.basics.item3.body: A ward councillor is your elected representative in local government. They represent your neighbourhood, raise local issues, oversee civic works, and help ensure municipal services respond to residents' needs.

transcribe.guide.meta.description: What a transcriber compares, and what to do when a value cannot be read.
transcribe.guide.heading: How to check an affidavit
transcribe.guide.lead: Citizens read these values to decide how to vote. What you save is published immediately, with no second check; public pages can take a few minutes to show it. Work from the scan, not from what looks likely. Use a laptop or desktop screen: the affidavit and the form sit side by side.
transcribe.guide.steps.heading: For each affidavit
transcribe.guide.steps.1: Press Start. You are given the next affidavit; you cannot choose the ward, party or candidate.
transcribe.guide.steps.2: The scan is on the left and the values the AI read are on the right. Find each value in the scan yourself.
transcribe.guide.steps.3: Check every field. Correct wrong values; choose Not declared or Cannot read where appropriate.
transcribe.guide.steps.4: Tick the single confirmation for the whole form, then select Save and continue, which stays greyed out until you tick. All fields are published together; Cannot read remains unresolved. Confirm only after checking every field in the scan, even when the AI's values look right.
transcribe.guide.steps.5: You have 10 minutes for each affidavit. A warning appears when 5 minutes are left. After that it is released for someone else to draw, and unsaved changes are lost. Closing the tab does not release it: use Resume on the Start page to carry on.
transcribe.guide.wrong.heading: Wrong ward or wrong document
transcribe.guide.wrong.body: If the affidavit is for a different ward, is not an affidavit, or belongs to another person, do not correct the values. Open Wrong ward or wrong document? at the bottom of the screen, say what is wrong (required, up to 500 characters) and select Send to an admin. Nothing you typed is saved, and the affidavit goes to the list of affidavits waiting for a match, which admins and curators work. The candidate's page keeps its current values until it is fixed.

curator.guide.meta.title: Curator guide — Bengaluru Votes
curator.guide.meta.description: What a curator is asked to do and the standard they work to
curator.guide.heading: How to work as a curator
curator.guide.lead: Citizens tell us when something on a candidate's page looks wrong. A flag is a field citizens have reported; each citizen report under it is shown separately. You check what they say against the candidate's affidavit and either fix the page or reject the flag with a reason. You also match affidavits that are waiting and correct a candidate's details in the editor.
curator.guide.flags.heading: Answering a flag
curator.guide.flags.1: Open the flag from Flags (the review queue). On a wide screen the affidavit is on the left and stays in view; Hide affidavit gives the form the full width and changes only what you see. On a phone you get a link, Open the affidavit in a new tab, above the form. The citizen's comment and the published value are on the right.
curator.guide.flags.2: Find the value in the affidavit yourself. A citizen's suggestion or link is a lead, not a source, and report counts are not evidence. Open a citizen's link only if you recognise the site, and never enter credentials or download files from it.
curator.guide.flags.3: If the published value is wrong, enter what the affidavit says, tick the confirmation and select Fix and publish. It is published immediately; public pages can take a few minutes to show it. Saving a value identical to the published one is refused.
curator.guide.flags.4: If the published value matches the affidavit, select Reject and give the reason. A flag on a candidate with no stored affidavit cannot be fixed: it can only be rejected.
curator.guide.reason.heading: The rejection reason is an internal note
curator.guide.reason.body: A rejection reason is an internal note for the next curator. Reporters are anonymous and are not told. Write it plainly: what the affidavit says and where. Never write a name, a phone number or a guess about anyone's motives.
curator.guide.ward.heading: A candidate in the wrong ward
curator.guide.ward.body: A flag on the ward is fixed by moving the candidate to the ward the affidavit names, with Move and publish. Their page, their place in the ward's list and any other open flags move with them. Use the current wards only. They are listed by corporation and number (for example South 14 · J.P Nagar): pick the corporation as well as the number, because the same number exists in each corporation. If the affidavit names an old ward you cannot match to a current one, do not guess: leave it for matching.
curator.guide.matching.heading: Affidavits waiting for a match
curator.guide.matching.body: Some affidavits could not be published because the ward was unclear, the name matches a candidate already here, or a transcriber sent them back. Compare the name, party and ward the AI read with the PDF, choose the ward, and for a same-name candidate decide whether it is the same person. If you are not sure, leave it waiting: a wrong match overwrites another candidate's page and cannot be undone.
curator.guide.notYours.heading: What is not your job
curator.guide.notYours.body: You do not re-read affidavits nobody flagged, oversee routine transcription or approve transcribers' work. When a candidate's affidavit is missing, report it to the admin; uploading affidavits and dealing with ones the AI failed to read are the admin's work. If you come across a wrong value while working, you may correct it in the candidate editor.
curator.guide.contact.heading: When to tell the admin
curator.guide.contact.body: A document that is unusable, belongs to somebody who is not standing, or is missing altogether cannot be fixed from here. Leave it as it is and message the admin directly, outside this app (it has no channel for this), quoting the candidate's name and ward (or the name and ward the AI read, for a waiting affidavit).
curator.guide.profile.heading: Editing candidate details
curator.guide.profile.body: Use Find a candidate on the dashboard: type at least two letters of the name; the first 50 matches are shown. The editor shows the seven report-card fields and the ward beside the affidavit. Candidate names and parties use the report-card fields and their Kannada translations, which are made automatically after you save. Correct the fields and ward, confirm once and select Save and publish. Only changed values are saved and marked checked. There is no undo, so check before you tick the confirmation.

staff.entry.heading: Entering a value
staff.entry.intro: Curators and transcribers use the same form for every field, with the same rules.
staff.entry.answers.heading: Three answers, and when to use each
staff.entry.answers.value: A value: you can read it in the affidavit. Write it in English, converting Kannada numerals.
staff.entry.answers.notDeclared: Not declared: the section is blank or missing. This is a complete answer. If the affidavit says nil for criminal cases, that is a value of 0 and 0, not Not declared.
staff.entry.answers.unreadable: Cannot read: something is written but you cannot make it out. The public page shows it as unresolved (“Could not be read from the affidavit”), and it is not counted as checked. A curator can fix it later in the candidate editor, checking the affidavit; until then the field stays marked as not read.
staff.entry.answers.partial: If only part of a field is unreadable, such as one of the two asset figures, choose Cannot read for the whole field.
staff.entry.fields.heading: What to type in each field
staff.entry.fields.nameParty: Name and party: type them exactly as printed on the affidavit, in English letters. Keep titles and initials as printed, and write the party's full name as printed, never abbreviated by you. For an independent candidate, enter Independent.
staff.entry.fields.lists: Gender is chosen from a list. Age is a whole number from 1 to 120.
staff.entry.fields.education: Highest level of education is chosen from a list: {levels}. “Qualification as written” takes the wording on the affidavit, in English.
staff.entry.fields.assets: Assets: whole rupees, digits only (commas are fine), for movable and for immovable assets. Use the totals the affidavit prints, added across the candidate, spouse, dependents and HUF, without subtracting loans. The screen adds the two for you. If the affidavit says nil for assets, choose Not declared.
staff.entry.fields.cases: Criminal cases: enter pending cases and convictions as whole numbers. Count the cases the affidavit itself lists as pending in its criminal-cases section, and do not interpret beyond it. If the affidavit says nil, enter 0 and 0. Count a case with a conviction only under convictions, even if an appeal is pending.
staff.entry.never.heading: Never guess
staff.entry.never.body: A wrong figure about a candidate's assets or criminal cases is worse than no figure. If you are not sure of a digit, choose Cannot read. If the affidavit leaves a field blank, choose Not declared. Both are honest answers. A plausible number is not.
staff.basics.heading: Your account and the screens
staff.basics.account: Your screens use the language saved in My account (Screen language, then Save language). Select Sign out when you leave a shared computer.
staff.basics.idle: You are signed out after an hour with no activity. Anything you typed and had not saved is lost, and signing in again brings you back to the page you were on.
staff.basics.keyboard: On screens with an affidavit, keyboard users can press Tab and choose “Skip the document and go to the form” to get past the PDF viewer.
transcribe.guide.steps.6: The AI confidence figure and any AI note are hints about where to look; they never replace checking. Check every field, even at a high figure. A field labelled AI-extracted becomes Checked by a person when you save it as a value, Not declared or a corrected answer.
transcribe.guide.steps.7: If a save is refused, nothing is saved. Fix the fields marked on the screen (what you typed is kept) and save again.
transcribe.guide.release.heading: If you cannot finish
transcribe.guide.release.body: Use Release this affidavit when you cannot finish, for example because you were interrupted. Nothing is saved and someone else is given it. Use Wrong ward or wrong document only when the affidavit itself is the problem. If you simply cannot read a value, choose Cannot read for that field; do not release.
transcribe.guide.after.heading: After you save
transcribe.guide.after.body: Your values are live and the affidavit leaves the queue. The Start page offers Next affidavit and shows how many you have saved today. A field you saved as Cannot read stays marked as not read until a curator fixes it.
curator.guide.flags.5: Fixing or rejecting closes only that flag. Other open flags on the candidate stay in the queue. If the field was reported before, read Previous reviews of this field first.
curator.guide.flags.6: In the queue, the Flags column counts citizen reports on the same field. Sort by most recent or by ward; Review opens a flag, which shows 20 reports at a time.
curator.guide.matching.intro: Some affidavits could not be published. Each row says why.
curator.guide.matching.1: The reasons are Ward could not be worked out, May be a candidate already here, and Sent back by a transcriber.
curator.guide.matching.2: Check the name, party and ward the AI read against the PDF, choose the ward and select Confirm and publish. A new candidate is published at once; its other values stay marked AI-extracted until a transcriber checks them.
curator.guide.matching.3: If Same person as lists a candidate you are sure is the same person, choose it: this affidavit's values are then added to that candidate, and the name, party and ward you typed are not applied. Otherwise leave Nobody: create a new candidate. If you are not sure, leave the row waiting: a wrong match overwrites another candidate's page and cannot be undone.
curator.guide.matching.4: For one a transcriber sent back, read their note, correct the name, party or ward if needed and select Save correction. The candidate is already public, and its other values stay as they are. The correction goes live immediately and is not sent to transcribers again.
curator.guide.matching.5: If someone else got there first you will see a notice, and there is nothing more to do.
curator.guide.profile.limits: Candidates cannot be added or deleted here. If a candidate has no stored affidavit, its fields cannot be edited: tell the admin. The editor has no photos, no election-status setting, no affidavit upload and no free-text box.
staff.basics.errors.curator: “You do not have access to this page” means your role does not include that screen. “We could not find that page” means the link is old or the item is no longer open, for example a flag someone has already handled.
staff.basics.errors.transcriber: “You do not have access to this page” means your role does not include that screen. “We could not find that page” means the link is old or the item is no longer open, for example an affidavit whose 10 minutes have run out.
curator.guide.matching.6: The Confidence figure on a row is the AI's own. Curators do not use it; it only decides the order in which transcribers are given affidavits.
curator.guide.profile.fixUnreadable: Any curator can fix a field a transcriber saved as Cannot read: open the candidate in the editor, check the affidavit and save. Until then the field stays marked as not read. There is no list of such fields, so find the candidate by name.
